smoke.purpose: per-game wall time, options firing, timeouts. Its score is NOT part of the screen and is not used.

screen.sizing: 205 s per game per worker (smoke) x 25 pairs x 2 games per worker at 4 workers = ~2.9 h. pair-seed 1 = the same 100 TEST pairs as the 2 s screen, so only the clock changed.
screen.read: ONCE, after all 200 games, with gate.js's result and solver/bench/adaptive_read.js.
screen.pass_rule: PASS iff the Wilson 95% upper bound of X's score is >= 0.5 AND X's point score is >= 0.47 (the stage-1 rule of solver/results/2026-09-27-adaptive-options/preregistration.json, unchanged). FAIL = do not run the SPRT; the options stay off.
screen.clock_rule: 0 decisions over 55 s and 0 games over 420 s of decision time for EITHER arm; 0 fallbacks; rollout_quiesced > 0. A breach is a FAIL whatever the score.
screen.equal_wall_clock_check: Reported, not part of pass/fail: X/Y ms per searched decision. If the ratio exceeds 1.10 the screen is NOT at equal wall-clock (the smoke read 1.18), and the SPRT recommendation must say how it matches time (e.g. Y's target raised so the means agree) rather than run as is.
screen.what_a_pass_means: No loss shown at 200 games (the interval is about +/- 0.07): necessary for the SPRT, not evidence that the options are stronger. The SPRT (elo0 0, elo1 +20) decides that.
